We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Information Technology \& Digital
   

  

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role ensures clear product vision, roadmap ownership, and strong value delivery, translating Genesis objectives into well‑defined product outcomes aligned to procurement priorities. This includes shaping product strategy, defining success metrics, prioritising backlogs, and ensuring products are delivered in line with agreed objectives, timelines, and governance standards.
   

  

 The Product Manager works closely with programme leadership, delivery teams, business stakeholders, and enabling IT\&D functions to maintain transparency, support informed decision‑making, and ensure that Genesis products deliver measurable business value. This includes contributing to executive forums (e.g. Steering Committee and EOLT) with clear product insights on progress, risks, dependencies, and benefits realization.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

**Product Strategy \& Ownership**

 Translate Procurement strategy and pain points into high‑value AI use cases, balancing innovation with practical business impact.
   

  

 Define product success through clear value metrics, KPIs, and adoption measures, ensuring benefits are realised and sustained.
   

  

**AI Product Delivery**
 Lead the end‑to‑end product lifecycle: discovery, POCs, MVPs, scaling, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Shape and prioritise the product backlog, working closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, and Architects.
   

  

 Ensure AI products are designed responsibly, with appropriate consideration for model performance, explain ability, data quality, security, and compliance.
   

  

**Stakeholder and External Partners Management**
 Act as the primary interface between Procurement, IT\&D and Partners/Vendors
   

  

 Partner closely with Procurement leaders across GBS to ensure tight business alignment on benefits delivery and adoption.
   

  

 Manage and govern relationships with external partners, ensuring outcomes, delivery quality, and knowledge Innovation and Thought Leadership
   

  

 Stay current with AI trends including LLMs, agent‑based systems, optimisation algorithms, game theory, and decision intelligence, and assess their relevance for Procurement.
   

  

 Champion experimentation and learning, helping the organisation move from proof‑of‑concept to scaled value.
   

  

 Act as an AI evangelist within Procurement, able to simplify complex concepts for non‑technical stakeholders.
   

  

 The experience we're looking for
   

  

**Skills/Experiences**
**Essential**
* 12\+ years of experience as a Product Manager delivering digital or AI driven products.
* Strong Procurement domain knowledge, particularly across the Source to Pay process.
* Solid understanding of AI and analytics concepts, including LLMs, ML models, algorithms, and data pipelines (hands on coding not required).
* Ability to work effectively in complex, matrixed environments with global stakeholders.
* Experience working with external vendors and partners to deliver technology products.


**Desirable**
* Experience delivering AI products in procurement, supply chain, or enterprise functions.
* Familiarity with concepts such as agentic AI, optimisation, simulation, and game theory.
* Experience operating within Agile / product led delivery models.
* Background in transformation, innovation, or advanced analytics programmes.


**Technical / Professional Qualifications:**
**Essential**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Supply Chain, Procurement, or a related discipline.

**Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query**
 Couchbase \| Product Organisation \| Bangalore, India \| Reports to VP of AI Product Management
   

  

**About The Role**
 Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL\+\+ query experience, secondary indexing, full\-text search, and vector and hybrid search.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.
   

  

 You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End\-to\-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL\+\+ query, global secondary indexes, full\-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.
   

  

 Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.

**About WisdomAI**
 WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data\-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup, currently \~30 people and growing.
   

  

**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
 This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands\-on function built for the age of AI\-native product development. We are a build\-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
   

  

 At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4\+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer\-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM\-first, Design\-first, or Dev\-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast\-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long\-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.


**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI\-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade\-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

* Calculation engine, including the multi\-year effort to build Tax Foundry — an AI\-enabled tax calculation and policy engine that replaces our third\-party dependency.
* Filings and agency communications across all jurisdictions globally.
* Tax payments and reconciliation — accurate, on\-time, and fully traceable.
* Upstream data audits and self\-serve resolution so issues are caught before they block filings.
* In\-product explainability so every tax value can be traced to its source inputs and rules.
* Enterprise readiness — multi\-entity, multi\-country, equity comp, and complex tax structures at scale.

* Build opinionated, configurable workflows that reduce reliance on Tax Ops and CX.
